ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels distributed as irregular mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density dark pigmentation concentrated at the peduncle junction and central lobe areas; high-frequency white mottling and distinct focal spots localized along the trailing edges and distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the center-line; narrow angular divergence between the two lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge, characterized by numerous jagged peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly concave curvature on the outer edges, sweeping sharply upwards to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters across both lobes, particularly dense in the mid-ventral regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of thin, light-intensity linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe, oriented diagonally to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular and potentially truncated morphology at both fluke tips; concentrated dark pigment transition at the base of the median notch.
